structure.unit: Regulation of Medical Care Facilities and Services
Hospital and Nursing Home Licensure and Inspection

text.section: For the purposes of this section: "Birth" includes both vaginal birth and cesarean section. "Doula" means a person who provides physical, emotional, and informational support to a pregnant person before, during, and after pregnancy. "Postpartum process" means the biologic process that happens to both the newborn and birthing person after delivery due to endogenous hormone systems.
